title: Speaking Multiple Languages Affects the Moral Bias of Language Models
findings: The paper presents no direct findings about religion. It finds that multilingual models encode moral dimensions, including those from the Moral Foundations Questionnaire which are often associated with religiosity (e.g., Purity/Sanctity). However, these encoded moral biases do not reliably correspond to human cultural differences, and models are highly sensitive to lexical cues rather than compositional meaning.
